definitions.explanation: An act that violates the law.
An immoral act, especially in a religious or moral sense.
The state of being responsible for wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: {罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}した→犯す：10059_okasu⟧。
examples.notes: {罪|つみ}を{犯|おか}す = to commit a crime

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{罪|つみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}われた→問う：02299_tou⟧。
examples.english: He was charged with a serious crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: He admitted guilt at the trial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嘘|うそ}をつく→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧⟦のは→の：09472_no⟧{罪|つみ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{償|つぐな}うために→償う：10883_tsugunau⟧⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I worked hard to atone for my wrongdoing.
examples.notes: {罪|つみ}を{償|つぐな}う = to atone for one's sins

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}にする→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦のは→の：09472_no⟧{罪|つみ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{気|き}がする→気：02199_ki⟧。
examples.english: Wasting food feels like a sin.
He is not guilty. / It's not his fault.

examples.japanese: {罪|つみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんでいる→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: I am tormented by feelings of guilt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}している→反省：03570_hansei⟧。
examples.english: I deeply reflect on my guilt.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}す→犯す：10059_okasu⟧ (to commit a crime/sin)
・{罪|つみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧ (to charge with a crime)
・{罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{償|つぐな}う→償う：10883_tsugunau⟧ (to atone for one's sins)
・{罪|つみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (to admit guilt)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (crime)
・⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧ (guilty)
・⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧ (innocent, not guilty)
・⟦{罪悪感|ざいあくかん}→罪悪感：05951_zaiakukan⟧ (sense of guilt)

COMMON EXPRESSION:
・{罪|つみ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a cruel person, someone who makes others suffer)
